note: Written in 2.7-data-loop phase 0, before agents/profiler.md exists. Evals 1-3 run from phase 1 (baseline none), 4-6 from phase 5, 7 from phase 6 (baseline previous); eval 1 is rerun as a regression in phase 5. The agent is exercised as a proxy: a general-purpose subagent given agents/profiler.md, started with the spawn block status.py --profile would print. Its tools list, the write guard and the decisions sync hook are not reproduced. Each eval's seed is a small git repository built by evals/sets/files/profiler/build.py case-<id>; the executor works in a mktemp copy and build.py collect copies what it changed into outputs/. The profile program needs uv and network access for duckdb; a harness sheet says what is recorded when either is missing. A Commit: sha in a prompt is the one build.py prints for that case; it changes if build.py or seed/trades.csv changes, and the prompt and the expectations that quote it are then updated with it.

expectations: outputs/docs/sources/ holds `rawtrades.md`, `rawtrades.profile.py` and `rawtrades.sample.json`, and outputs/changes.txt lists no other path: nothing under `packages/`, nothing under `data/`, nothing under `docs/packages/`, and not `docs/decisions.md`

outputs/docs/sources/rawtrades.md has these twelve headings, each spelled exactly and in this order: Access, Provenance, Shape, Observed schema, Duplicates and keys, Checks, Quirks, Unexplained, Expected and not found, Rounds, Cost and time of a full pass, Sections served; Access gives `Location:` as `data/raw/trades/` and says `on disk`

Under Checks is a table with one row per check id `C<n>`: a rule, a non-empty `judged against` cell naming a document and heading or a comparison, and the rows failing beside a denominator: 306, or the number of rows the check reads when its rule or a line under the table says which rows it leaves out (300 for a neighbour check that sets the 6 exact copies aside); under Rounds a `### Round 0` block gives the rows failing per check

Every kind under Quirks is one line of the form `- K<n> <name> — checks C<…>; <count> of <denominator>; <one clause>; proposed: <repair | drop | quarantine | flag>; <D? | no decision needed>; unverified`: every kind names at least one check id that is in the Checks table, no kind line reads `verified`, and none carries a numbered `D<n>`

The kinds include one for exact duplicate rows whose count is 6 (the second copies) or 12 (both copies) of 306, one for a negative price whose count is 4 of 306, and one for a timestamp out of order within a symbol whose count is 5 of 306, or 5 of 300 when the profile says its check reads the rows with the 6 exact copies left out

The row with trade_id 500156 (venue `ZZ`) is accounted for: it is the one row of a kind of its own, or it is counted under Unexplained; Unexplained gives `<n> of <all failing rows>`, and n is 0 only when every failing row is in a kind

outputs/docs/sources/rawtrades.sample.json parses as JSON with one key per kind id written under Quirks, each holding between one and five rows, and a key `accepted` holding exactly five rows; every row carries its `trade_id`; no row under `accepted` has a negative price or venue `ZZ`

outputs/docs/sources/rawtrades.md has a `## data/clean` heading under Sections served, and the last line under it is `Round 0 — <date> — commit none — pending verify`; it is the only round line in the file

outputs/docs/sources/rawtrades.profile.py holds every check of the Checks table as a query with its `C<n>` id; transcript.md shows it run as `uv run --with duckdb python docs/sources/rawtrades.profile.py`; outputs/store-files.txt lists `.dev-team/data/rawtrades/rounds/0/failing.parquet` and `.dev-team/data/rawtrades/rounds/0/counts.json`

outputs/commit.md stages only the three `docs/sources/rawtrades.*` paths, nothing under `.dev-team/`, and the final message in transcript.md starts with the line `Result: done` and is ten lines or fewer
